title: Align neutral palette and density-aware elevation rules
creator: Ava Patel
description:
Problem: Our current neutral color ramps and shadow/elevation rules were designed for generous spacing and standard card-centric layouts. With the product moving toward denser table and compact form factors, surfaces read as either too flat or overly elevated at small scales. The goal of this ticket is to introduce a reconciled neutral matrix (semantic anchors + perceptual interpolation), a density-aware radius/spacing delta system, and a new illumination-driven elevation grammar that scales with content density and z-distance. This should preserve accessibility contrast, reduce visual noise in dense lists/tables, and provide predictable token aliases for engineering to consume.

Scope:
- Define a 3-step neutral matrix (base, muted, strong) with perceptual adjustments (L*a*b* tuning) for light/dark modes.
- Introduce density deltas: compact / default / spacious spacing and radius token variants and mapping rules.
- Replace ad-hoc shadow presets with an illuminance model: elevation = function(distance, density); generate corresponding shadow steps and overlay opacities.
- Provide migration aliases so existing components map to new tokens with a deprecation plan.
- Update core docs, token spec, Figma libraries, and a small component audit (buttons, tables, cards) to validate results.
acceptance_criteria: Neutral matrix defined with hex + L*a*b* references for each step and both themes
Density delta tokens created (spacing/radius) with a mapping table for compact/default/spacious
Illuminance elevation model documented and 6 shadow steps generated with CSS variables and numeric examples
Component audit completed: visual diffs for buttons, table rows, cards, and chart overlays across densities
Migration guide and alias map published; deprecation schedule set (90 days for legacy tokens)
Automated contrast checks pass against WCAG AA for primary surface/text combinations
implementation_notes: Engineering should expose three token sets for spacing/radius: --sp-compact, --sp-default, --sp-spacious and alias component tokens to these variants
Shadow tokens will be generated from a single formula; provide both CSS box-shadow strings and numeric elevation values for runtime adaptation
Use color-utils pipeline to convert L*a*b* tuned values to sRGB for export; include commentary on rounding tolerances to avoid banding
Add a runtime feature flag to enable density-aware tokens per route; default to existing look until migration completes
qa_checklist: Run visual regression snapshots for Desktop and Mobile for compact/default/spacious densities
Contrast-check primary/secondary labels on each surface step in both themes
Verify migration aliases render identically for at least 90% of audited components
Validate token exports (JSON, SCSS, CSS vars) match Figma token names and values
Ensure theme-switch does not cause layout shift beyond 2px for core controls
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Slight color shift may break brand-sensitive placements. Mitigation: add 'brand-exempt' alias table and run manual review with marketing for flagged screens.
Risk: Shadow formula could increase perceived noise in charts. Mitigation: scope chart overlays to use reduced-elevation presets and run a separate chart-a11y pass.
Risk: Migration churn for open-source consumers. Mitigation: publish clear alias map and a codemod script in the repo to automate most replacements.
rollout_plan: Week 1: Finalize token values and publish to Figma + token repository (alpha)
Week 2: Implement token aliases in component library and ship behind feature flag
Week 3: Run component audit, gather sign-off from Product and Accessibility
Week 4: Flip default tokens and start 90-day deprecation window for legacy tokens
